items.title_en: Zero-click PlantUML diagram egress to www.plantuml.com
items.title_zh: PlantUML 代码块零点击外发完整图源至 www.plantuml.com

maintainer_response.summary_en: Official triage confirmed the issue (79m) and merged PR #25582 to main (7.5h after filing).
maintainer_response.summary_zh: 官方分诊 79 分钟内确认缺陷，提单 7.5 小时后合入 PR #25582。

remediation.verification_summary_en: Verified commit f59df558: plantuml defaults to source view (including streamed transitions) and PlantUmlPreview gates remote www.plantuml.com fetches behind an explicit host-disclosing click per mount; shipped v2.2.3 remains affected until a newer release.
remediation.verification_summary_zh: 已核验提交 f59df558：plantuml 默认展示源码视图（含流式语言切换），打开预览先提示将发送至 www.plantuml.com 且未点击前零外发；已发版 v2.2.3 仍受影响，待下个正式版本包含。

events.summary_en: Filed upstream bug issue referencing 62867d8f and v2.2.3.
events.summary_zh: 基于 62867d8f 与 v2.2.3 提交上游缺陷 Issue。

events.summary_en: Official triage recorded non-egress acceptance criteria while PR #25582 was open.
events.summary_zh: 官方分诊记录决策；社区贡献者已提交 PR #25582。

events.summary_en: PR #25582 merged to main 7.5 hours after filing; issue closed as completed.
events.summary_zh: 提单 7.5 小时后 PR #25582 合入 main，Issue 标记 completed 关闭。

events.summary_en: Verified source diff at f59df558 eliminates zero-click PlantUML egress via source-view default and per-mount explicit remote consent gate (remote renderer remains opt-in; awaiting release beyond v2.2.3).
events.summary_zh: 源码核验 f59df558 通过默认源码视图与显式远端提示门禁消除零点击外发（远端渲染改为显式点击触发，待新版本发布）。

items.title_zh: 手动导入 MCP 点普通确认即默认 isTrusted: true 并触发连接

maintainer_response.summary_en: Verified every cited line in 4m; triage card decided in 28m to align manual import with protocol installs (isTrusted: false + explicit trust prompt).
maintainer_response.summary_zh: 4 分钟内核实全部代码行，28 分钟内决策卡拍板对齐协议安装（先写 isTrusted: false，显式确认信任后再连接）。

events.summary_zh: 基于 62867d8f 提交上游缺陷 Issue。

events.summary_en: Official triage card recorded decision to initialize manual MCP imports as isTrusted: false / isActive: false pending explicit trust confirmation.
events.summary_zh: 官方决策卡拍板：手动导入 MCP 改为默认 isTrusted: false / isActive: false，须显式确认信任。
